youtube.title: Shapes with Noodle! (BOING!) | Nerdy Noodles
youtube.description:
🔷 BOING! Noodle bounced way too high and all the shapes flew away! Can you help find them?

Learn 7 shapes with Noodle in the park: circle, square, triangle, rectangle, oval, diamond and hexagon! Each shape comes back one by one, and Noodle tells you something special about it, like how many sides it has. Then sing the shapes song together, and stay till the end, because a sleepy surprise shape peeks out! 🌙

Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten kids (ages 2-6).

✨ In this video, kids will:
✔️ Learn 7 shapes: circle, square, triangle, rectangle, oval, diamond and hexagon
✔️ Count the sides: a triangle has 3, a square has 4, a hexagon has 6
✔️ Spot shapes in everyday things (an oval like an egg, a diamond like a kite)
✔️ Sing a catchy shapes song with Noodle!

⏱️ Chapters
0:00 BOING! Oh no!
0:05 Let's find the shapes!
0:22 Sing along!
0:40 Wait... who's that?
0:52 What shape is your window?

💬 What shape is your window? Tell us in the comments!
